call_points.text: FY27 capex guidance is about ₹25,000 crores, covering utility scale, distribution, transmission and hydro, with a similar outlay expected in FY28.
FY26 capex was about ₹13,000 crores, short of plan as right-of-way and transmission delays pushed projects into FY27.
About 5 GW of in-house renewable projects are under implementation; half completes in FY27 and half in FY28.
FY27 renewable additions are guided at about 2 GW, of which solar is 1.5 to 1.8 GW, mostly hybrid and FDRE.
Coal cost is a pass-through under the SPPA, so Indonesian export duty or royalty changes flow to procurers.
Delhi distribution booked ₹783 crores of prior-period regulatory approvals in FY26, against ₹333 crores in FY25.
Odisha DISCOM FY26 PAT was ₹809 crores against ₹439 crores the previous year; management expects FY27 to peak.
Tata Projects is expected to return to profit in FY27 as legacy projects are nearly complete.
Coal asset monetisation stays on hold until all state SPPAs are signed and valuations are clear.

operating_notes.text: Tata Power total portfolio stands at 16.3 GW, with 7.5 GW of clean energy generation constituting 46% of total capacity.
TPREL approved upstream solar PV Ingot and Wafer manufacturing capacity up to 10 GW with an investment up to ₹6,500 crore.
Total identified hydropower capacity under the DGPC partnership increased to 5,033 MW with the addition of the 404 MW Nyera Amari project.
FY26 debtors turnover was 86 days in Q4FY26 against 67 days in Q4FY25, and inventory turnover 113 days against 61 days.
Mundra plant operations were permitted under MoP Section 11 directions from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026 on SPPA terms with GUVNL, with other procurers' approvals in progress.
The Group recognised an additional ₹74 Cr expense on gratuity and leave encashment liabilities under the new Labour Codes, of which ₹62 Cr is treated as a tariff pass-through.
FY26: TP Solar produced 3,825 MW of modules and 3,759 MW of cells, with revenue of ₹6,968 crore and PAT of ₹857 crore.
FY26: Renewable portfolio stands at 11.6 GW, including 5.1 GW under construction; TPREL crossed 10 GW of cumulative solar EPC execution.
FY26: Transmission portfolio at 7,403 Ckm, including 5,562 Ckm operational and 1,841 Ckm under construction.
FY26: TP Solar cell and module plant delivered PAT of ₹857 Cr, more than double the previous year.
FY26: Odisha DISCOM PAT was ₹809 Cr against ₹439 Cr the previous year; rooftop solar PAT was ₹499 Cr.
About 5 GW of in-house renewable projects are under implementation, half completing in FY27 and half in FY28.
Tata Power and DGPC signed an MoU to establish a skill development ecosystem for the development of 5,000 MW clean energy capacity in Bhutan.
Reported a 2.8 GW+ data centre opportunity pipeline across 18 operators, supported by a ₹15,000 crore Mumbai Grid Upgradation and Expansion Plan.

timeline.summary: Tata Power incorporated a wholly-owned subsidiary, TP Urja Limited, with ₹5 lakh capital in April 2026.
Tata Power announced a partnership to deploy a 12,100 TR Cooling-as-a-Service solution at Intellion Park, Chennai, under a 15-year contract.
Tata Power's subsidiary TPREL approved a ₹6,500 Cr investment for a 10 GW solar PV ingot and wafer manufacturing facility.
Tata Power JV signs **$515 million** financing for **1,125 MW** Dorjilung Hydro Project in Bhutan
2026-05-08: Tata Power amended its MoU with Bhutan's DGPC to add the 404 MW Nyera Amari hydropower project, raising total partnership capacity to 5,033 MW.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹14,900.2 Cr (-12.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹995.91 Cr (-4.5% YoY).
Tata Power reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹15,962 Cr and EBITDA of ₹4,216 Cr, with annual FY26 PAT reaching ₹5,118 Cr.
Tata Power’s **Vispi S. Patel (FCS 7021)** shared the **Analyst Call recording** for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via the company website on May 12, 2026.
2026-05-12: Tata Power held its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting FY26 PAT above ₹5,000 Cr and guiding for ₹25,000 Cr capex in FY27.
Tata Power signed an MoU with Druk Green Power Corporation to build a skill development ecosystem for 5,000 MW of clean energy capacity in Bhutan.
Tata Power signed an MoU with Imperial College London on October 13, 2026, to collaborate on next-generation energy systems and net-zero technologies.
Tata Power announced a 2.8 GW+ data centre opportunity pipeline backed by a ₹15,000 crore Mumbai grid upgradation plan.
